notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
・Adjusted enemy movement speed (main story only, no changes in Time Attack)
・Fixed an issue where the framerate dropped in certain stages

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear when playing with keyboard and mouse while a controller was connected.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed an issue where players could interact with the portal at the same time they were caught by an enemy.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug where unintended effects played during the ending branches
・Extended the grace period for certain traps
・Adjusted enemy screams so they play from the correct position
・Adjusted supporter content switches to function properly

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content: ・Fixed a bug that occurred after clearing Time Attack.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the ranking board could not be accessed
・Other minor adjustments
